scope: Native macOS Japanese token geometry prerequisite only; separate from frozen English-Swahili/Spanish alignment arm. No app/runtime activation or translation calls.

resource_admission.basis: Small standalone Swift CLI with measured existing cache reuse; not a full app build/model-preparation admission.

retained_initial_failure.effect: All accepted originals reconstructed, but projected emoji/currency/combining-mark callback surfaces were mislabeled word. NFD José split across one grapheme.
retained_initial_failure.correction: Generic Unicode surface kind and adjacent-boundary coalescing only inside original grapheme. Raw native ranges and all protected intervals exactly unchanged.

limitations: 37 retained authored/provider diagnostic cases, not corpus or population coverage.
Native first means first call in this process, not cold OS boot or model cache.
Two URI-with-Japanese boundary cases remain conservative opaque ranges with explicit ambiguity diagnostics. Not a general URI/Markdown parser.
Projected native calls operate on exact nonliteral regions and may segment differently from whole text; raw whole-text ranges are retained.
No readings, lemmas, senses, translation meanings or alignment quality inferred from tokens.
One over-limit input is explicitly rejected; it is not counted as an exact partition.
8MiB output guard can stop a batch; callers must inspect completion and retain any prefix rather than claiming full coverage.
